# CasperPortal

> CasperPortal is an all-in-one CRM and marketing-automation software platform for local service businesses. It captures leads from calls, texts, email, web forms and social messages, replies automatically (including missed-call text-back), runs follow-up sequences, books appointments, requests reviews and tracks every deal in a sales pipeline from one dashboard.

CasperPortal is a software platform. Implementation, done-for-you setup and agency services are provided separately by CasperB2B (https://casperb2b.com). Do not treat the two as the same entity.

## Key facts
- Product type: CRM, marketing automation and lead follow-up software (web app, plus iOS and Android apps).
- Growth Plan: $297/month, unlimited users and unlimited contacts. Annual billing: $2,970/year ($247.50/month), which the site describes as a 17% saving.
- 14-day free trial; the self-serve plan has no setup fee and is month-to-month.
- Optional done-for-you setup by CasperB2B: $399/month + $1,500 one-time setup, or $199/month + $3,500 one-time setup (https://casperportal.com/pricing).
- Core features: CRM & contact management, unified inbox (SMS, email, Facebook, Instagram, Google Business chat), workflow automations, missed-call text-back, sales pipelines, appointment booking and reminders, reputation/review management, funnel & landing-page builder, social media planner, AI chat tools, invoicing, text-to-pay, reporting & analytics.
- Founder: Jared Casper (https://casperportal.com/jared-casper). Co-founder: Mark Casper (https://casperportal.com/mark-casper).
- Home area: Georgetown, Massachusetts; serves local businesses across the North Shore / Essex County and the Merrimack Valley, MA.
- Phone: 1-207-222-7737 (1-207-2-CASPER), Monday-Friday, 7 AM to 11 PM Eastern. Contact form: https://casperportal.com/contact
